title: My Funny Uncle and Clever Cousin
text:
My uncle is very funny. He tells jokes every day. He is also generous. He often buys ice cream for us.

My cousin Tom is shy. He does not speak much at parties. But he is very clever. He loves solving puzzles.

questions.text: What does the uncle tell every day?
How does the uncle probably feel about the children?
options: He likes them and wants to share things

questions.text: Why does Tom probably not speak much at parties?

vocabulary.definition: willing to give things to other people
feeling nervous when you meet or talk to other people
able to learn and understand things quickly

paragraph_translations: Mój wujek jest bardzo zabawny. Każdego dnia opowiada dowcipy. Jest też hojny. Często kupuje nam lody.
Mój kuzyn Tom jest nieśmiały. Na imprezach nie mówi zbyt wiele. Ale jest bardzo bystry. Uwielbia rozwiązywać zagadki.
